# MCP: General Client
Calls a tool on a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
## When to use
- A scenario needs a capability exposed by an external MCP server.
## How it works
1. Meant to load the `aiservers` record named by `aiserver` to get the server URL and API key. 2. Calls the MCP tool named in `runoperation`, passing the agent context, then runs the children.
## Inputs
None. It does not read any values from the agent context.
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `aiserver`: Id of the `aiservers` record for the MCP server - `runoperation`: Name of the MCP tool to call
## Notes
- No Spring bean named `mcpClientAgent` is registered in plugin.xml, so this skill cannot run yet. The closest implementation is `McpClientSkill`.
## Implementation
- Bean `mcpClientAgent`: not registered - Agent type: `remoteagent`
